measurement: Resident AgencyContext.resolve only; construction, disk I/O, inference and routing excluded
dataset: Existing Boston indexed timetable, unchanged between runs
runtime: Node.js 26.7.0, macOS 26.5.1, Apple M2, 16 GiB RAM
method: Three consecutive batches of 100 alternating queries per implementation, one resident context per implementation, performance.now around each batch. The first batch is included; no separate warmup. All queries run synchronously.
limits: Small local microbenchmark; match totals agree, fixture tests separately cover identity semantics. This is not an end-to-end latency or LLM speed claim.
